description: Use this when the user wants articles, guides or background reading on a perfume, fragrance, cologne, house, note or topic (for example layering, vetiver, how to make a scent last). Returns matching Scento journal articles with title, one-line summary and scento.com link in the user's language. Use it to give the reader something to read on. Don't use for a perfume's notes (perfume-portrait), a house profile (house-portrait) or a term's meaning (perfumery-lexicon).

continuation.description: The "continuation" value from a previous answer, passed back unchanged to get the next part of the list.

lang.description: Language of the scento.com links and labels; answers stay in English. Use the language the user writes in, for example "de" (German), "fr" (French), "es" (Spanish) or "it" (Italian). Default "en".

q.description: A perfume, house, note or topic to find articles on. Examples: "vetiver", "layering", "Creed Aventus", "make a scent last".

name: journal-search
title: Search the Scento journal
